# FLUX 3 generate, then edit — optional references, bounding boxes

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-generate-edit-refs-boxes.json`](../flux3/flux3-generate-edit-refs-boxes.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 26 |
| Links | 22 |
| Paid API calls per run | **2** |

---

Lay out a new image with boxes, optionally pulling an element from a reference photo, then edit that image box by box, optionally placing something from a second reference. Every reference and every box is a switch, so the same graph runs as plain text-to-image or as a full multi-reference composite.

### Stage 1 — generate
A caption from the **Shared Prompt** plus layout rows for `background_1` and `table_1`, joined by **Layout Prompt**. `aspect_ratio` is fixed at **4:5**, the shape the boxes are drawn for. It is deliberately not `auto`, so switching a reference on never changes the frame.

**Bottle source** (always one) chooses where `bottle_1` comes from:
- **Bottle · generated from desc** — a `layout` row; the model invents the bottle from its `desc`.
- **Bottle · from reference image** — a Load Image plus a row with `from: ref_image_0` whose `src_bbox` marks the bottle in your photo and whose `tgt_bbox` places it in the layout. Measure `src_bbox` on your photo; it is `[0, 0, 1000, 1000]` here, a product shot that fills its frame.

### Stage 2 — edit
Stage 1's image becomes **image 1** (`ref_image_0`). **Keep** rows anchor the backdrop, table and bottle; the instruction is a core **Text (Multiline)** node. `resolution` is **match_input**, so the edit stays at stage 1's size.

**Label source** (always one) chooses the new `label_1`:
- **Label · written text** — a `new` row: text reading "NORTH", generated in the box.
- **Label · logo from reference** — a Load Image on `input_image_2` (**image 2**, `ref_image_1`) plus a row taking the logo from it into the label box.

**Edit stage** switches stage 2 off entirely while you settle the layout. Bypassed, it passes stage 1's image through, so its Save writes a copy of stage 1.

### How the switches work
A bypassed **Load Image** sends nothing, so that socket is simply left out of the request. A bypassed **Box Element** passes the rows above it through untouched, so its row drops out of the table. Both reference groups start **bypassed**, so the graph runs with no images at all.

References are numbered by the sockets that are actually connected. Stage 2's logo is image 2 only because stage 1's result fills socket 1. If you rewire, renumber the `ref_image` on the rows to match.

**Image Comparer** sets stage 1 against stage 2; each stage's **Display Any** shows the prompt FLUX 3 actually ran, boxes included.

### Cost
2 FLUX 3 Image calls, or 1 with Edit stage off. `variation` is fixed on both, so changing only stage 2 never re-bills stage 1.

### Needs
[rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) for the switches, comparer and displays.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** holds stage 1's caption. It emits a plain string, **not** a list, so the nodes it feeds run once each.
